metadata.content: A dynamic medium shot focusing on a stylish individual showcasing the product. The model must have a fashionable and high-end appearance. The interaction should focus purely on aesthetic presentation and posing (avoiding functional application motions like spraying or applying). If the interaction method for a specific SKU is uncertain, uniformly adopt a standard hand-held display.Special emphasis: Anatomically incorrect limbs (e.g., deformed fingers) are strictly prohibited. Display poses should be diverse; *randomly* select one from the following options (When using the following poses, do not add any quotation marks; please use them directly, for example, 'She is performing a Face-Side Lift pose.'): 1.[Shoulder-Level Display] Holding the product upright at shoulder height with the elbow tucked down naturally near the body (not raised), positioning the item slightly forward and to the side of the jawline to frame the face, looking at the camera; 2. [Relaxed Fashion Portrait] A tight close-up of a model interacting with a perfume bottle near her jaw. Casual and fluid pose, not stiff. Her hands are elegantly placed in an asymmetrical way, one hand hovering closer to the lens to create depth. Tousled hair, head tilted. Direct engaging eye contact, shot from a slightly low angle to look empowering; 3. [Foreground Extension] Extending the arm naturally towards the lens, placing the product in the foreground focus with the model blurred in the background; 4. [Palm Reveal] Placing the product flat in the palm, with the palm facing the camera; 6. [Neckline Grace] Holding the product gently near the collarbone using ONLY ONE hand with the elbow tucked down comfortably; the other arm must be completely relaxed by the side (not touching the face or neck). The head is tilted slightly to reveal the elegant neck line; 7. [Profile Glance] Model standing in profile, holding the product near the shoulder, turning head to look at the camera; 8. [Mysterious Obscure] Using the product to partially cover the face (such as lips or one eye) to create a sense of mystery. The staticImage of this B-roll must include the following sentence in the last sentence: 'There can only be one {SKU name} entity. Only one product entity is allowed. Text, logos, and SKU names are strictly limited to the product packaging. Absolutely no text/stickers/tattoos/typography are allowed on the model's skin, face, or background. Commercial-grade advertising photography.'. This SKU name must appear as the unique visual focal point only in the hands of the model. Strictly prohibited: Duplicate product instances, floating copies. (Note: Natural optical reflections on surfaces are acceptable, but distinct duplicate objects are not).The background should be a stylized high-end lifestyle scene. Common aesthetic elements must be subtly incorporated. Ensure even and flattering lighting in the scene. **MUST** append this exact constraint block at the end of the prompt: (CRITICAL: The product is STRICTLY handheld by the model only. NO podiums, NO glass stands, NO water ripples in the background, NO floating objects.) .
